cases_readback: webhook missing or incorrect verify token returns 401 and exact token is accepted
webhook fails closed with 503 when server verify token is not configured
session start rejects unverified tenant scope
session start returns 404 without active tenant configuration
configured tenant returns CONFIGURADA_SIN_SESION with null QR and explicit provider requirement

contract_points: webhook verify-token secret is server-side configuration and missing configuration fails closed
session start requires authentication plus Configuracion.Editar permission
tenant scope is verified before configuration lookup
invalid EmpresaId, forbidden tenant and missing active configuration have explicit HTTP error semantics
the API does not fabricate a provider session or QR and reports CONFIGURADA_SIN_SESION until a real provider materializes a session
correlation identifier is present in security-relevant warning logs

finding: The current BACKEND_API boundary already satisfies the current-standard WhatsApp contract. No speculative backend/provider implementation is justified in N8.6.D; inventing a session, QR or delivery result would violate fail-closed semantics.
provider_boundary: Real provider session/send/webhook runtime proof is explicitly deferred to N8.6.G by the fresh N8.6.A/N8.6.B evidence. This review does not claim provider connectivity or delivery.
